programme.title: 幸福的青鳥:1
programme.desc: 如果沒有那段負債的磨難，或許她與生俱來的那份慈悲不會被激化；若不是抱著吃苦而了苦的悲心，或許她與慈濟那段不可思議的因緣不會發生；如果不是吃井水長大，或許她不會如此深刻體悟上人所講古井水的道理出生在通霄鄉下的美玉是家中的么女，父母的善良兄姐的疼愛，美玉從小就戀家，貼心；但因是家中么女，個性中難免有些霸道和得理不饒人的倔強眾多兄姐中，四姐與美玉只差兩歲，感情最為要好，同時四姐也是影響她最深的人美玉從未想過要當護士，是四姐的一句話改變了她的選擇美玉也從未想過一個第一次約會就遲到的男子（昌枝）會成為自己的終身伴侶，又是因為四姐，她與昌枝結為連理美玉家中雖不富裕，但因兄姐的先行付出，從小到大美玉沒有吃過很多的苦工作期間，美玉的善良和細心贏得病人的信賴和同僚的肯定結婚後，美玉與昌枝收入不多，但很穩定，日子過得節儉平順隨著一對兒女的出生，更添幾分美滿一九八五年，這一切的順景

programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族

programme.desc: 1945年，村岡花子邊看原文小說，邊翻查著字典，將譯文撰寫於稿紙上這一年她已經52歲，正在進行小說Anne of Green Gables的翻譯工作此時正值二次大戰末期，節節敗退的日本正遭受盟軍轟炸機的密集轟炸，因此花子在工作時，還得隨時注意外頭的狀況，若發布空襲警報，就得帶著女兒到防空洞避難每當避難時，她手上必定帶著書本及譯稿，對花子來說，這是比她的生命還重要的東西這天她一如往常的進行翻譯工作，她突然停下了筆，開始回想她這一生的經歷，花子與安妮的故事就此展開

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版

1997勢不兩立
programme.desc: 一名億萬富翁查爾斯陪著任職模特兒的妻子一同前往阿拉斯加取景拍照，在旅途中，他發現自己的妻子與攝影師巴布的感情超乎尋常，兩人長期合作的深厚友誼也開始變質而事實上，巴布正暗中計劃要除掉查爾斯，以謀奪他的財富與美麗的妻子有一天，巴布邀請查爾斯一同探險並尋找攝影題材，在飛機上，兩人各懷心事就在兩人衝突一觸即發的時候，飛機發生意外，被迫在阿拉斯加的深山降落，這次意外讓處於對立面的兩人不得不相互合作，以抵擋在深山可能面臨到的各種危險，他們面臨的最大敵人是一頭大棕熊

programme.title: 汪洋血迷宮
programme.desc: 空無一人的郵輪，隨處可見的詭異，繼忌日快樂之後，又一燒腦鉅作餐廳女服務生潔絲，與罹患自閉症的兒子湯米兩人相依為命某日，好友葛雷格邀她與友人搭遊艇出海遊玩出門前，湯米打翻顏料，她清潔時有人按門鈴惡作劇，她安撫好兒子，便打包行李出發出海不久，萬里無雲的天氣突然變成狂風暴雨，遊艇因此翻覆，落海的他們，爬上翻覆的船底，這時，一艘郵輪經過，他們登船後，卻發現船上空無一人，而這一切令潔絲覺得似曾相識

programme.title: 光輝歷程特潔思
programme.desc: 恐怖逼近，她無所畏懼，奮戰到底印度女空軍特潔思獲知有同袍墜機，緊急動員搭機前往拯救，她不顧個人安危，違反上級指令，降落禁區順利解救同胞身負重傷的她，在三天後清醒，並從新聞得知陸軍學校爆炸案由巴基斯坦恐怖組織首領卡圖尼所策畫，他在公開影片中威脅將對印度發起更多攻擊不久，她從新聞中發現當年同窗好友普拉夏，竟被卡圖尼俘虜且刑求，這下子，特潔思將要如何拯救他呢？！

programme.title: 神鬼傳奇
programme.desc: 英俊的探險人瑞克歐肯納（布蘭登費雪），與他狡猾的同伴比尼（凱文歐康諾），在1923年的一場戰爭中，一起意外發現了被毀壞的哈姆納塔城數年後，當瑞克變成戰俘等待被槍決前，他發現他對該城的發現成為救命的條件，埋藏在哈姆納塔城底下的豐富資源成為尋寶人與考古學家的寶藏，瑞克與一群很不理想的隊員合作，包括美麗但又少根筋的埃及古文化專家艾佛琳卡娜漢（瑞秋懷茲）以及她讓人又愛又恨的哥哥強納森三人的旅程將穿過尼羅河，橫跨寬廣的薩哈拉沙漠，並將經歷許多超出想像的神奇力量但他們不是唯一追尋哈姆納塔城寶藏的隊伍，還有另一隊由美國人組成的探險隊目的與他們相同，目地在奪取被詛咒之城的豐富財寶；除此之外，還有亞爾德拜依（歐德法爾）所領導的木乃伊教派軍隊的阻撓，他們誓死阻止邪惡祭司印何闐復活重回人間

programme.title: 玩命快遞
programme.desc: 曾是特種部隊的法蘭克，自營快遞工作，並堅持三不鐵則：不改交易不問姓名不看包裹對他來說，破壞規矩，就是玩命的開始這時，他接獲最新指令，替人運送一個約50公斤的包裹，在運送過程中，他發現他的包裹會動，好奇心驅使下，他打破了第三條規矩，發現包裹裡面竟然是一個被五花大綁的東方女子

programme.title: 毀滅大作戰
programme.desc: 昔日摯友瞬間變成摧毀世界的狂暴巨獸，地表最強巨獸空前集結！一場失控的太空基因實驗墜落地球，引爆全球末日浩劫！溫馴的白化症猩猩野狼與鱷魚意外接觸變異催化劑，體型瘋狂暴增至高樓等級，且刀槍不入，將繁華的芝加哥城瞬間變成殘酷的巨獸遊樂場為了喚醒摯友白化症猩猩心中殘存的人性，巨石強森火力全開，賭上性命！

programme.title: 安娜
programme.desc: 在美麗外表下，她用智慧出奇制勝神祕女子進入酒店，殺光店內所有惡徒後轉身離去隨後，她因涉及軍火商歐格命案，遭美國中情局探員李奧審問，因監視器僅拍到她進出酒店畫面，無明確的殺人罪證下，李奧只能將她釋放在李奧明查暗訪下發現她是活躍巴黎時裝界的名模安娜，也是隱身法國的俄羅斯女間諜？！為了生存，安娜將如何在美俄諜報戰中，替自己找條生路呢？！

programme.title: 雙面圍殺令
programme.desc: 兩大臥底冤家路窄，互不相讓的兩人，瞬間淪為獵物？！一場美墨邊境的毒品交易，FBI 精英探員與 DEA 王牌臥底在偏遠交貨點狹路相逢，掀開底牌才發現彼此都是自己人正當兩人因調查重疊而驚愕時，神祕狙擊手突然攻擊他們面對失控的局勢，互不相讓的宿敵，被迫組成生死同盟，背靠背殺出一條生路！

programme.title: 狡兔計畫
programme.desc: 在安身處一個人枯燥乏味工作12個月的馬修，渴望成為正式探員，來證明自己的能力，直到頭號叛徒托賓到臨他萬萬沒想到，他第一次接待的人，竟然是善於心理戰略的頭號叛徒托賓隨後，在傭兵摧毀襲擊下，馬修被迫帶領托賓離開現場，進行潛藏任務在與間諜老鳥托賓相處下，馬修開始對自己原有的理念產生質疑，但現在，他必須決定相信長官，還是眼前的大叛徒

programme.title: 鐵猴子傳奇之邊城困獸
programme.desc: 面對生死博弈，唯有拳頭，才能打碎這場奪命陰謀！龍山寺方丈慧雲離奇失蹤，為了查明真相，龍山寺向醫術高明且武藝精湛的楊天淳求援為此，楊天淳化身鐵猴子，潛入一個神祕的地下組織，揭發該組織利用武功祕笈金錢與綁架手段，強迫一群武林高手進行殘酷的賭鬥在這以命為注的黑暗賭局中，失敗者的下場就是死亡這下子，鐵猴子必須在重重危機中識破背後的陰謀，並在困境中救出被囚禁的高手們與失蹤的方丈

programme.title: 鐘點戰
programme.desc: 在這個世界裡，時間是貨幣，人類可以隨心所欲地操控，富者長生不老，窮者生命短暫，不管他們活了多久，基因讓他們永遠保留在25歲，而26歲後，他們必須用勞力賺取呼吸的時間某日，威爾意外解救一名來自新格林威治的富翁亨利，獲得一筆可觀的時間財富，隨後，他卻被鎖定為謀殺案的嫌犯，為了逃亡，他綁架了一名富家千金席薇亞

programme.desc: 故事從非常和平的一天開始，洛杉磯跟平常一樣的繁忙，居民都過著平常的生活在早上9時14分時突然發生了1次地震，地質學家艾美博士向傳媒宣佈震央位於棕櫚谷，強度為4.9級本來正在休假的洛杉磯危機處理中心主任馬克亦要把自己的女兒凱莉交由鄰居照顧後返回危機處理中心工作，身為工作狂的馬克亦很快投入工作，檢視市內一切狀況雖然看上去這次地震似乎未有造成太大的影響，但過了不久，在早上9時47分時麥克阿瑟公園發生了懷疑爆炸事故，七名維修下水道的工人被活活燒死在事發現場，而另1名嚴重燒傷的生還者則送到聖文森醫院進行治理，並發現傷者不是被蒸氣燒傷，而是被另1種不明物質所導致

programme.title: 愛麗絲的難題:6

programme.title: 浩克慢遊:74
programme.desc: 天很藍，世界很大我揹上背包，迎著陽光，享受寧靜五月，稻田由翠青轉為墨綠眼前的這熟悉景致，許久以來，和我們的生活緊密相連農人穿梭田中，白黃色汗衫在大片的綠中，格外明顯上學的小學生急忙跑過旁邊的小徑，差點撞上沾滿泥土的老野狼再仔細觀看，雲的流動，讓陽光在田中染上不同層次的綠，稻浪不規則的轉換樹枝的擺動落葉的方向，讓我看見風心要夠靜，旅行的況味才得以擴展開來童年的旅行叫遠足，關注的是書包得裝滿平日難得吃到的零食，至於去哪裡倒不是那麼重要年輕時的旅行，拚的是疾走的氣勢，一路騎車到墾丁，早上吃完包子，還可以在沙灘上奔跑一整天現在的旅行，我會放慢腳步，聆聽不期而遇的滿滿人情台灣的美，絕對處處充滿驚喜

programme.desc: 這是一段花甲老熟肉與少年小鮮肉們，跨越大齡差距，結伴而行的明星青春旅行到底小鮮肉們想什麼？而老熟肉們又會怎麼玩？透過世代差異，激盪出觀眾意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅遊實境節目，紀錄跨世代的藝人們難忘的友情之旅！

programme.title: 全民星攻略
programme.desc: 由館長曾國城擔任知識把關者，考驗著每個來挑戰九宮格益智遊戲的藝人明星想要攻略九宮格關卡，透過創意聯想邏輯推理理性分析，才有機會獲取智慧星幣，帶走夢幻大獎

programme.title: 效廉出發吧！今天去哪玩
programme.desc: 全新型態與組合的旅遊綜藝實境節目:逗趣大叔-許效舜熱血青年-廖威廉兩人逍遙環島瘋玩台灣這是一段見證男人友誼的旅行,帶著簡單行囊 騎上熱血摩托車欣賞每個城鎮獨有的歷史人文,探索體驗每個地方的特色美食與生活,分享彼此人生故事,更彌足珍貴的是知己談心為彼此充電,有別其他旅遊美食節目的樂趣和放鬆

programme.title: 柳舟記
programme.desc: 淮陽王崔行舟（張晚意 飾）年少有為，一生以剿滅仰山匪徒為己任柳眠棠（王楚然 飾）為仰山女寨主，帶領仰山眾人懲惡揚善某日，行舟救下受重傷失憶的眠棠，豈料她醒來後竟將行舟誤認為夫君崔九，行舟則誤以為眠棠是仰山頭領的寵妾，便將計就計假扮她的夫君探消息，想誘敵現身眠棠跟隨行舟守護邊關，兩人從客氣相處，進一步發展成兩情相悅，無奈身份被識破，感情又將面臨考驗?

programme.title: 主君的太陽
programme.desc: 個性樂觀如太陽的女子太恭實（孔曉振 飾），因發生事故後，成為可以看見鬼魂的人，她每天被鬼魂騷擾並生活在驚恐之中，使得她生活日夜顛倒精神不濟某日，恭實遇到個性高傲的購物中心社長朱中元（蘇志燮 飾），她不小心碰觸到中元的身體，沒想到這些騷擾她的鬼神竟立刻煙消雲散！那次之後，恭實決定巴著中元不放，並且把他當成自己的防空洞，兩人之間的不解之緣及愛情故事就此展開?

programme.title: 背著善宰跑
programme.desc: 柳善宰（邊佑錫 飾），Eclipse樂團主唱，外貌實力兼具的韓國頂流明星，看似風光的人生卻承受著許多壓力在他19歲的時候，其實最愛的是游泳，而且還有一位暗戀的女孩任率（金惠奫 飾），15年前因為一場意外終生不良於行，喪失求生意志的她，因為善宰的歌曲有了堅持下去的勇氣，決定振作並成為他的鐵粉新聞傳來善宰死亡的消息，小率卻神奇地回到高中發生意外前，那時她的雙腿不但行動自如，更遇上高中時期的善宰，她能改變過去，為兩人創造不一樣的未來嗎？

programme.title: 世上最漂亮的女兒
programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子（金海淑 飾），含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善（裕善 飾）是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉（金素妍 飾）是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱（洪宗玄 飾）後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧（金荷景 飾）曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.desc: 徐家世代經營一間專門服務亡者的照相館，替鬼客們拍照幫助其投胎轉世，第七代老闆兼攝影師徐奇洲（周元 飾）也承襲這門家業與家族的詛咒家族男性皆無法活過35歲隨著生日將至，奇洲開始受到阿飄們的威脅，幸好平日身邊有鬼夥伴高成浩（劉仁秀 飾）白南九（陰問錫 飾）相助某日他意外發現熱血律師韓春（權娜拉 飾）竟是個不受阿飄干擾的安全區，為了互惠互利，兩人決定一起經營照相館，展開來往於陰陽兩界的驚險故事?

programme.title: 全民星攻略

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行
programme.desc: 這是一段花甲老熟肉與少年小鮮肉們，跨越大齡差距，結伴而行的明星青春旅行到底小鮮肉們想什麼？而老熟肉們又會怎麼玩？透過世代差異，激盪出觀眾意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅遊實境節目，紀錄跨世代的藝人們難忘的友情之旅！

programme.title: 雲之羽
programme.desc: 自小在無鋒長大的雲為衫（虞書欣 飾）奉命參加宮門選親大典，以新娘身份潛入探查情報，豈料在執行任務期間，宮門的執刃和少主突遭刺殺，原本被排除在宮門事務之外的宮子羽（張凌赫 飾），倉促登上執任之位，為衫的任務目標轉為子羽，也順利成為他的新娘外冷內柔的子羽，因家族鬥爭而對身邊所有人都保持距離，唯獨對聰慧堅韌的為衫敞開心房，兩人開始了一段充滿算計危機與愛情的關係為衫在步步殺機中，逐漸看清兩大勢力背後更深的陰謀，她必須在情感與忠誠間做出抉擇?

programme.title: 進擊的台灣

programme.title: 理財必修課

programme.title: 效廉出發吧！今天去哪玩

programme.title: 洪興仔之江湖大風暴
programme.desc: 打仔洪興，四仔東星是一句江湖上流傳已久的話洪興的老大洪勝與子洪飛梁朝偉父子不和已多年，因當年洪勝為救幫中兄弟舍棄了妻女的性命，飛對此一直耿耿於懷小春陳小春乃阿B手下，向來開殺時聲音大，膽子卻很小，但他是飛的崇拜者，一次小春在與東星的廝鬥中被東星幫少主阿寶和垃圾追殺，幸好飛經過救下小春小春遇到偶像十分興奮，在一次賽車中把自己的妹妹小彤李若彤介紹給飛認識彤是一家報館的記者，聰明活潑，且對江湖上的事情非常好奇，因此對飛非常感興趣，在交往的過程中逐漸兩人產生了感情在洪勝金盆洗手的當晚，東星幫眾人到場挑釁，要求洪勝交出曾打傷阿寶的小春，正好飛前來澄清了事實，東星的人灰溜溜離去，但飛父子倆為了當年的事情再度衝突，飛憤憤離去...

programme.title: 金派特務
programme.desc: 根據線報，大量走私槍枝即將流入韓國，菜鳥特務流茶熙被指派前往韓國進行機密調查，為確保任務順利，進而尋求國情局的優秀臥底協助，卻陰錯陽差遇上笨手笨腳又貪財的私家偵探禹手罕兩人聯手調查，不僅零默契且漏洞百出，還讓相關人證都莫名被消失，甚至被當成頭號嫌疑犯！究竟這兩個超母湯特務，能不能保全性命，並順利完成任務呢？

programme.title: 西遊．降魔篇
programme.desc: 這是個妖魔橫行的世界，百姓苦不堪言年輕的驅魔人玄奘以捨小我，成大我的大無畏精神，歷盡艱難險阻，依次收服水妖豬妖，以及妖王之王-孫悟空，且收他們為徒，並用愛將他們感化，而玄奘自己在這段驚險萬分的過程中，也終於領悟到了大愛的真意為救天下蒼生於水火，為贖還自己的罪惡，師徒四人義無反顧的踏上了下地獄般的西行取經之路

programme.title: 掃毒3-人在天涯

programme.desc: 1942年10月10日，在慶祝國民政府成立三十週年的盛典上，一名汪精衛政權中的機要大員遇刺身亡，引起駐華日軍一片譁然皇軍特務頭子武田（黃曉明飾）研判，這次行動乃由地下抗日組織首腦，代號老鬼的人物所策劃他準備利用這個機會，一舉攻破由老鬼旗下的情報組織

programme.title: 麻雀王
programme.desc: 20多年前，阿發（杜汶澤 飾） 和阿順（李國煌 飾） 都是麻將天尊儒五常（曾志偉 飾）的徒弟但如今阿發在怡保老街角落一間殘舊咖啡店賣釀豆腐，這間小店生意不算很好，但也過得去，最主要是這裡有一 群幾十年的老顧客，因此生意無憂阿發的妻子雷夢娜（葉璇 飾） 多年前已經出走，丟下他獨自撫養女兒四喜，如今四喜已是個花樣年華的少女

programme.title: 我裡面的那傢伙
programme.desc: 黑道老大板壽被意外從高樓墜落的弱雞高中生東賢撞上，兩人因此靈魂互換，板壽也展開奔波於校園和穩固地盤的笑鬧高中人生同時還得面對自己原本身體仍陷入昏迷敵人趁機奪取地盤的陰謀就在接連出現的問題讓板壽頭痛不已時，變成黑道大哥的東賢終於醒來

programme.title: 捉妖記
programme.desc: 某天，一對神祕夫婦與懷有小妖王的妖后逃到永寧村，遇上了善良的天蔭以及降妖少女小嵐，天蔭更陰差陽錯下成為代理孕夫誕下小妖王胡巴葛千戶重金懸賞小妖王小嵐為了得到賞金，拉著天蔭展開了一段奇幻旅程可愛的小妖王胡巴出生，令天蔭和小嵐關係起了奇妙變化，同時也揭發了一個重大祕密

programme.title: 錦衣衛-修羅戰場
programme.desc: 明朝天啟七年，北鎮撫司錦衣衛沈煉（張震 飾）在一次掃除亂黨任務中，為救畫師北齋（楊冪 飾），失手將同僚淩雲鎧（武強 飾）殺害此後便將自己陷入無盡深淵，一方面要應付來自陸文昭（張譯 飾）裴綸（雷佳音 飾）輪番質疑與調查，另一方面還被神秘女子要脅要放火燒了錦衣衛經歷司，並助她暗中挖掘醜陋的真相

programme.title: 總舖師
programme.desc: 楊祐寧夏于喬林美秀吳念真柯一正聯合演出 20多年前，台灣辦桌界有三大傳奇總舖師稱霸北中南！分別為憨人師吳念真飾鬼頭師喜翔飾與蒼蠅師柯一正飾，鄉民們尊稱他們人鬼神三霸隨著時代變動，辦桌文化勢微，人鬼神凋零蒼蠅師想將家傳手藝交給獨生女詹小婉夏于喬飾，誰知小婉只想當明星，美美出現在螢光幕前但一心逃離油煙血水的小婉卻被迫面對巨大的挑戰和使命..... 原來想當明星的小婉的星途走的並不順遂，再加上遇上一個惡意留下債務給她揹的男友，於是只好跑路回家鄉；豈料自己的母親過的也不好，因為自蒼蠅師過世後，其弟子阿財師便接收所有的生意，而小婉母親的廚藝又不好，更是惹出麻煩，最後也落入跑路一途母女兩人便相依為命地開了一間小麵館，雖然生意因故而時好時壞，總是可以維持生計 有一天，一位來歷神秘的客人因故決定教小婉幾道辦桌的菜餚...

programme.title: 大囍臨門
programme.desc: 本片耗資1.1億新台幣，由大尾鱸鰻聯合導演黃朝亮執導陳國華監製，本土喜劇天王豬哥亮主演浩角翔起主演 32歲的淑芬終於要結婚了！不料，淑芬的老爸李金爽（豬哥亮飾）看這憨女婿是越看越不爽，不捨女兒外銷，規矩訂得比101大樓還要高！聘金的數字迎娶的人數流水席的禮數婚禮的禁忌，要說到完口水都沒沫 還好大囍媒婆錢頌伊（林美秀 飾）有PRO級手腕Everybody嚨嘛愛；眼看新娘就要娶進門，卻突然哭跑了！安娘喂～吶安捏？

programme.title: 角頭-大橋頭
programme.desc: Michael哥（王陽明 飾）回來了，他跟天借膽 ，帶著瘋蠍子（張懷秋 飾）想拿下頂莊北城北館，在貴董（高捷 飾）哈達（太保 飾）勇桑（蔡振南 飾）的眼皮子底下賣藥，甚至想仗著自己幾分交情，拉攏勇桑的二把手清楓（孫鵬 飾），沒想到被打得灰頭土臉， 卻在這時，他看不上眼的土狗們阿猛（施名帥 飾）阿慶（鄭人碩 飾）宗保（張再興 飾），竟然能闖入仁哥（王識賢 飾）憨春（陳萬號 飾）的賭場，搶下巨款，還活著回來，讓他又驚又喜

programme.title: 鬼才之道
programme.desc: 做人好難，當鬼更難！菜鳥新鬼同學死得平庸，到陰間又驚覺自己即將魂飛魄散，唯一辦法是成為讓世人難忘的都市厲鬼傳說鬼的才華，就是嚇人的才華！她不得不接受厲鬼經紀人Makoto邀請，與過氣厲鬼天后凱薩琳同心再造魯蛇飯店猛鬼傳奇

programme.title: 偉大的隱藏者
programme.desc: 元流煥（金秀賢飾）接受潛行任務，潛入南韓京畿道富川的月亮村，裝成傻子除了元流煥，還有國家高層幹部的兒子李海浪（朴基雄飾），他必須成為南韓的歌手，以及偽裝成高中生的間諜李海真（李玹雨飾），與當地村民打成一片，聽候組織下一步的差遣，指派任務 元流煥願意成為間諜最大原因除了是對祖國的忠誠，也是為了守護身在祖國自己母親的安全長時間在南韓的生活，以及受到善良熱心鄰居的影響，讓他逐漸對自己的信念產生質疑

programme.title: 宮:9
programme.desc: 講述了身為古董店繼承人的女主人公誤入時空隧道，穿越至清朝康熙年間，在入宮成為一名宮女之後，陷入了康熙朝九子奪嫡的明爭暗鬥和諸阿哥們的情感糾葛之中，最終雖明知前途兇險，仍與心上人相守不離不棄的故事

programme.title: 鬥陣來發財
programme.desc: 台灣有個樸素平凡的大寶村，村民們人人勤奮不已，生活簡單快樂有一天，剛死老公的風騷錢嫂開了一家樂透店，原本對樂透完全不感興趣的村民們，卻因為窮鬼來富中了一次四星，全村漸漸掀起買獎券的熱潮，更一窩峰的開始求明牌，各種花招不停出籠，陷入瘋狂即將結婚的年輕人小馬與朋友們也擋不住金錢的誘惑迷失了自己，差點就失去了人生最重要的的東西沒想到，在結婚典禮上，一張樂透獎券又即將引發另一場風暴

programme.title: 警察故事
programme.desc: 身兼導演的成龍所扮演的香港員警家駒，奉命守護一名關鍵證人，好指證他單槍匹馬逮捕的毒梟 但他卻被清秀的證人愚弄，致使毒梟因證據不足而開釋

programme.title: 佛跳牆
programme.desc: 李翰祥執導的佛跳牆共有四個單元，首個故事是描述一對母子因施予濟公一碗豆漿而逃過喪命之危；其二則說濟公幫助賣菜漢，逃離高利貸者的滋擾；其三則寫濟公以櫻桃化夜明珠，將大盜教訓一頓；最末一則是描寫濟公以巧計捉弄胡作非為的相爺父子李翰祥借濟公的善行，針貶權貴惡霸的種種惡行，為平民大眾吐一口烏氣

programme.title: 爛賭英雄
programme.desc: Lolanto好賭成性，經常鑽研賭術他與好友阿帆一同於某廣告公司上班，在一次簽約場合，Lolanto遇上賭王江大新，在賭癮發作下，不小心羞辱了江大新一番Lolanto受上司斥責，Lolanto竟驕傲稱相信江大新本人器量

programme.title: 賭神
programme.desc: 賭神高進受日本山口組的上山委託來港與殺父仇人賭魔鮑漢林決戰進看出主事人南哥等人出千，出手反千贏回大量巨款而去南哥不憤指使越南殺手追殺進上山先生委派龍五保護進火拼中，進頭部受重傷不支倒地記憶全失，被刀仔及其女友收留賭摩之助手南哥得知進等藏身於銷魂別墅即派數拾殺手追殺，追殺期間進漸回復記憶，再和賭摩在牌上決戰一場

programme.title: 排球少年!!-日語:9
programme.desc: 自從在電視上看了一場排球總決賽後，國中生日向便深受啟發，儘管身高不如人，仍然參加排球社，開始受訓

programme.title: 排球少年!!-日語:10
programme.desc: 自從在電視上看了一場排球總決賽後，國中生日向便深受啟發，儘管身高不如人，仍然參加排球社，開始受訓

programme.title: 鹿鼎記:22
programme.desc: 鹿鼎記是金庸的封刀之作，也是金庸篇幅最長，風格最為獨特的作品，它是一鄰悲劇性的英雄史詩，是金庸為其昔日筆下創造出的無數江湖英雄唱出的一曲無盡輓歌，小說以清代康熙年間的社會歷史為背景，描寫了一個出身於社會最底層的少年韋小寶的傳奇經歷

programme.title: 神雕俠侶:49
programme.desc: 楊康之子楊過自幼流落江湖，被故人郭靖收留後又送到了全真教磨練叛逆的楊過忍受不了折磨，逃出全真教誤入古墓派，被小龍女收留，授以武功後因李莫愁攻入古墓而面臨生死，二人由師徒之誼發展成了刻骨銘心的愛戀因為蒙古鐵騎即將南下，郭靖等人等難以匹敵，關鍵時刻，小龍女和楊過無意中捲入紛爭，打敗金輪國師但好事多磨，楊過與小龍女多次聚散，在經歷了武林大會襄陽鏖兵，絕情幽谷等等險境後，更有十六年的生離死別...

programme.title: 神雕俠侶:50
programme.desc: 楊康之子楊過自幼流落江湖，被故人郭靖收留後又送到了全真教磨練叛逆的楊過忍受不了折磨，逃出全真教誤入古墓派，被小龍女收留，授以武功後因李莫愁攻入古墓而面臨生死，二人由師徒之誼發展成了刻骨銘心的愛戀因為蒙古鐵騎即將南下，郭靖等人等難以匹敵，關鍵時刻，小龍女和楊過無意中捲入紛爭，打敗金輪國師但好事多磨，楊過與小龍女多次聚散，在經歷了武林大會襄陽鏖兵，絕情幽谷等等險境後，更有十六年的生離死別...

programme.title: 青春還鄉2025地方創生微電影:6
programme.desc: 近年，有愈來愈多的年輕人用地方創生的方式回到家鄉創業，運用原本所學的專長，改善既有生產模式，以品牌行銷模式，推動在地經濟，創造地區共好也有原非當地居民因為熱愛土地，移居偏鄉，靠著熱忱與信念，努力推廣在地文化與產業，讓文化能夠繼續傳承，環境也能永續發展

programme.desc: 有故事的台灣物產有故事的台灣農漁人，以及熱愛土地的知名料理人，共同挑戰一場風味轉身的旅程節目走訪台灣山林與海洋，從產地到餐桌，帶領觀眾探索台灣物產的前世今生，深入農漁現場，貼近生產者的日常與堅持，聆聽土地孕育出的動人故事每一集將同時邀請知名主廚以獨特的料理視角重新詮釋在地食材，將產地面臨的挑戰化為創新的風味，讓每一道料理不只是美味，更承載土地人情與永續的價值，完成一場從產地到餐桌的精彩風味轉身

她她她的少女時代:11
programme.desc: 人到中年，營役半生，方迎風的人生卻迎來遽變！失婚失業，女兒離巢，她迷失她頑抗，卻體力衰退與社會脫節身為別人的女兒老婆老媽，她卻忘了少女時代，也曾是個熱血勇悍瘋狂追星的搖滾樂迷！二十年前的輕狂歲月，二十年後的柴米油鹽，面目全非的她，竟重遇當年迷戀的偶像！偶像潦倒不堪，丈夫欲斷難斷，種種挫折與衝擊，迫使她直面過去的失敗，重新振作，激勵自己與身邊人唱著一首首動人歌曲，一群失意的中年男女，再次出發，為了自己，再活一次！

programme.title: 大醬園:9
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山與夫人席德容堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿及葉細么兩女加入，與其子萬卓楓成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石啟川及啟江醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！

programme.title: 她她她的少女時代:13
programme.desc: 人到中年，營役半生，方迎風的人生卻迎來遽變！失婚失業，女兒離巢，她迷失她頑抗，卻體力衰退與社會脫節身為別人的女兒老婆老媽，她卻忘了少女時代，也曾是個熱血勇悍瘋狂追星的搖滾樂迷！二十年前的輕狂歲月，二十年後的柴米油鹽，面目全非的她，竟重遇當年迷戀的偶像！偶像潦倒不堪，丈夫欲斷難斷，種種挫折與衝擊，迫使她直面過去的失敗，重新振作，激勵自己與身邊人唱著一首首動人歌曲，一群失意的中年男女，再次出發，為了自己，再活一次！

programme.title: 大醬園:11
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山與夫人席德容堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿及葉細么兩女加入，與其子萬卓楓成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石啟川及啟江醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！

programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: 10 Things I Hate About You ((我恨你的十件事))

programme.title: Countdown ((絕命倒數))

programme.title: Notorious Nick ((折翼悍將))

programme.title: Plane ((飞机陷落))

programme.title: Another Earth ((另一个地球))
programme.desc: Tragedy connects a young woman and a shattered music professor as an exact replica of Earth is discovered.

programme.title: Sweet On You (很甜蜜)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep35 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep35))

programme.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt S1 Ep01 (海洋前物业猎 S1 Ep01)
programme.desc: Laura and Brandon have always wanted to live by the ocean and give their children the nautical life. After a major bathroom flood forces them to move, they decide its time to make the leap. (劳拉和布兰登一直想住在海洋边,让他们的孩子们有着水上生活.)

programme.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt S1 Ep02 (海洋前物业猎 S1 Ep02)
programme.desc: Dawn met Carey while working on the West Coast, where they started their family. Now that Carey has retired, Dawn has convinced him to move back home with her to the East Coast. (唐在西海岸工作时见到凯利,在那里他们建立了家人.)

programme.title: Rachael Rays Meals in Minutes S4 Ep05 ((Rachael Ray - 百度百科 S4 Ep05))
programme.desc: Rachael puts a bold spin on Johns favourite Roman classic, carbonara, by layering in the rich flavours of speck and a hint of saffron. To balance it out, she serves a refreshing take on panzanella.

programme.title: 1,000 Ways to Dine Ep07 ((中文名 Ep07))
programme.desc: Grab your map and your appetite as host Michael Yo sets his sights on the best off-road eats. Buckle up as we hit the backroads for bison burgers in Alabama and Brussels sprouts behind bars in Connecticut. (抓住你的地图和你的食欲,当主持人迈克尔·约定视线对最好的非公路餐饮, 起来,当我们进入阿拉巴马州的牛汉堡和布鲁塞尔在康涅狄格州的子后面.)

programme.title: 1,000 Ways to Dine Ep08 ((中文名 Ep08))
programme.desc: Your table is ready and its time to get served in the most unusual ways. Join host Michael Yos journey to Thailand for crispy flying fried chicken, then dinner is served with a side of sassy lip service. (加入主持人迈克尔·约斯前往泰国吃的炸,然后晚餐提供一面的唇服务.)

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out S2 Ep15 ((挤痘大师: Breaking Out S2 Ep15))
programme.desc: Dr. Lee is ready to take the lead on her first surgery since her stroke, with Dr. Townley now assisting. Quentin has a big bump on his tricep that is ruining his career and making his girlfriend miserable. (李博士准备在她中风以来的第一次手术中起带头作用,汤利医生现在正在协助她。昆汀的腿部有一大块裂痕,这破坏了他的事业,使他的女朋友悲惨不堪。)

programme.title: Rachael Ray in Tuscany Ep19 (雷切尔·雷在托斯卡纳 Ep19)
programme.desc: Rachael prepares her favourite Sicilian dish, pasta con le sarde, or sardine pasta, using both canned fish and fresh sardines atop long-cut pasta. (拉切尔准备她最喜欢的西西里菜,)

programme.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt S1 Ep07 (海洋前物业猎 S1 Ep07)
programme.desc: Dalene and Pete have lived a nomadic life for many years and want to find an oceanfront home to put down roots while still sparking their creativity. Will they be able finally to settle down? (达琳和皮特多年来一直在游牧生活,希望找到一个海的家园,)

programme.title: A Pickleball Christmas ((匹克球圣诞节 - 百度百科))
programme.desc: After winning the biggest match of his career, professional tennis phenom Luke Hollis is ready to hang up his racket and take over familys tennis club. (职业网球现象卢克·霍利斯赢得了职业生涯中最大的比赛后,)

programme.title: Rachael Rays Meals in Minutes S4 Ep06 ((Rachael Ray - 百度百科 S4 Ep06))
programme.desc: Rachael puts a spicy twist on the classic hot brown sandwich by adding jalapeo bacon, shredded pepper jack cheese and bold Mexican flavours.

programme.title: 1,000 Ways to Dine Ep09 ((中文名 Ep09))
programme.desc: Tune is as host Michael Yo takes us to places set to satisfy the palate, while also challenging our ideas of a dining experience. Our first stop is a sushi-bar and game-show joint in New York City. (音是主持人迈克尔·约带我们去满足口腔的地方,同时挑战我们的想法, 餐饮体验.)

programme.title: 1,000 Ways to Dine Ep10 ((中文名 Ep10))
programme.desc: Join Michael Yo as he circles the world for meals that cant, wont and dont stop. Take a ride in a speedy elevator up a thousand feet to the highest revolving restaurant in Canada. (加入迈克尔·约,他环游世界,吃饭,不停,不停,乘坐快速的电梯上升一千英尺,)

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out S2 Ep16 ((挤痘大师: Breaking Out S2 Ep16))
programme.desc: Craig fears the massive growth on his neck could prevent him from helping his sick mother. Gwen is covered in dry, itchy patches that are causing hair loss and devastating her confidence.

programme.title: Rachael Ray in Tuscany Ep20 (雷切尔·雷在托斯卡纳 Ep20)
programme.desc: Author and chef Sara Moulton joins Rachael in her Tuscan kitchen for a cooking challenge. Both Rachael and Sara create mystery meals using ingredients from Rachaels Tuscan pantry. (作者兼厨师萨拉·莫尔顿加入拉切尔的托斯卡厨房做一个的挑战.拉切尔和萨拉都使用拉切尔的托斯卡厨房的成分创造了神秘的餐饮.)

programme.title: The Face I Cant Forget ((无法忘怀的脸))
programme.desc: After waking from a car accident with total amnesia, Mia is taken home to be cared for by her loving husband and daughter. But as she recuperates, Mia has flashbacks of a second daughter. (经过一场车祸,完全失忆,米亚醒来后,被带回家,被她爱的丈夫和女儿照顾.)

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World S1 Ep01 (巨猫,小世界 S1 Ep01)
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. (热烈欢迎的春天在戈莫蒂河, 鹿菲福和狮子萨巴教他们的幼儿生存技能,)

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World S1 Ep02 (巨猫,小世界 S1 Ep02)
programme.desc: Track Molelos pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs. (随着冬季洪水的到来,他们因照顾幼儿而疲, 追踪莫莱洛的骄傲.)

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S1 Ep06 ((Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly 当幸福来敲门 S1 Ep06))
programme.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Livs hand during a tense rescue. (随着杰斯和丹从一个游戏区提取一个鱼时,请小心,当一个猎在紧张的救援过程中压利夫的手时,)

programme.title: Lifes Journey S1 Ep03 ((时间之旅 S1 Ep03))
programme.desc: For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animals legacy. (传递你的基因给下一代是每一个动物的遗产.)

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand S1 Ep01 (最野生的新西兰S1 Ep01)
programme.desc: At the waters edge a brave group of male penguins gather, preparing to make the dangerous journey ashore. With many threats ahead, there is safety in number and these petite penguins.. (在水边,一群勇敢的雄性企聚集在一起,准备出发危险的航行到岸边.)

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand S1 Ep02 (最野生的新西兰S1 Ep02)
programme.desc: New Zealands West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. (尼西兰西海岸是地球上没有其他地方的.从冰川覆盖的山脉到雨的原住民森林到的冰冷海,)

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand S1 Ep03 (最野生的新西兰S1 Ep03)
programme.desc: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier (在新西兰,两座野生堡垒保护弱势本土动物:一个是靠盐水沟保护的偏远岛屿,另一个是靠近防捕食者防护的山顶城堡)

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand S1 Ep04 (最野生的新西兰S1 Ep04)
programme.desc: Spring on New Zealands east coast is a time of promise for the New Zealand Fur Seal and the Norther Royal Albatross. Theyve returned to their land to breed. (鱼和北方皇家鱼在新西兰东海岸的春天是有希望的时代.)

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand S1 Ep05 (最野生的新西兰S1 Ep05)
programme.desc: New Zealands isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. (新西兰的孤立岛屿是著名的异常天堂,)

programme.title: Alaskan Summer ((阿拉斯加之夏))
programme.desc: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. (每天近20小时的阳光,能让丰富的季节充满.)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1 Ep06 ((马拉威野生拯救队 S1 Ep06))
programme.desc: Join the rescue as Amanda and Mandy try every trick in the book to help a snared hyena, a lion threatens a village, and the teams plan to release a troop of 13 monkeys is thwarted. (Amanda和Mandy在书里想尽一切办法 帮助一只被诅咒的野狼 一只狮子威胁着一个村庄)

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1 Ep01
programme.desc: Bonaires fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1 Ep02
programme.desc: The Florida Keys is the first line of defence for the southern US. Its easy to believe locals who claim these waters are home to as many as 1000 shipwrecks.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1 Ep03
programme.desc: The Bahamas is known as the underwater movie capital of the world. Hollywood has been coming here for decades, making epic movies and TV shows in its crystal clear waters.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1 Ep04
programme.desc: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But its not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2 Ep01 ((野性标志 S2 Ep01))
programme.desc: Every day a struggle for survival plays out across Africa. Predators binge on the dead and natures undertakers circle above waiting for their chance. (每天,非洲各地都在争取生存,捕食者都在食死者,)

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2 Ep02 ((野性标志 S2 Ep02))
programme.desc: Their ancestors were the first vertebrates to colonise dry land and they inhabit every continent except Antarctica, but their world is rapidly changing. (他们的祖先是第一个殖民干旱的脊椎动物,)

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2 Ep03 ((野性标志 S2 Ep03))
programme.desc: Once abundant on the continent, elephant populations have been drastically reduced by hunting for ivory and meat in the last 200 years. (象群在过去200年中因象和肉类的猎杀而大幅减少.)

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge S1 Ep01 (饥饿游戏:阿拉斯加大熊挑战S1 Ep01)
programme.desc: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova. (随着比赛的第一阶段开始,醒来后,与七只饥饿的熊一起息.)

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge S1 Ep02 (饥饿游戏:阿拉斯加大熊挑战S1 Ep02)
programme.desc: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip. (加入狂热的冲击,以利的鱼运行,与第一阶段的获胜者和一些艰难的新兵一起.)

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge S1 Ep03 (饥饿游戏:阿拉斯加大熊挑战S1 Ep03)
programme.desc: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom. (随着十月份的冰风, 让赛车复杂, 看到大在脚后跳跃,)

programme.title: In for the Kill ((Kill it 雙面殺手))
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight. (惊叹地看看掠食者在捕食猎物时使用巧妙,敏捷和快速的方法.)

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution S1 Ep01 ((Mysteries of X战警：进化 S1 Ep01))
programme.desc: The evolutionary journey of life on Earth spans millions of years - and the results are as diverse as they are jaw-dropping. (地球上的生命的进化过程持续了数百万年,结果是多样化的,)

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1 Ep01 ((Wild Side of 从地球到月球 S1 Ep01))
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1 Ep02 ((Wild Side of 从地球到月球 S1 Ep02))
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1 Ep01
programme.desc: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Superbeast S1 Ep03 ((超级野兽 S1 Ep03))
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins. (亲眼目睹动物的能力,超出人类的能力. 通过敏感的顶,鱼如何检测到最小的运动,发现子内部的GPS系统,并使用第七感来检测海豚的猎物.)

programme.title: Superbeast S1 Ep04 ((超级野兽 S1 Ep04))
programme.desc: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks. (使用自然界最狡猾、最有弹性的战斗机部署生化武器。 与科莫多龙一起释放毒气,用蒙古暴徒抵抗有毒的敌人,并看到鸟类用打骨的力量来对付有毒的攻击。)

programme.title: Wild Latin America S1 Ep03 ((魅力南美洲 S1 Ep03))
programme.desc: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru. (亲眼目睹眼熊的尬和魅力,玩,食,并在秘鲁北部的偏远的夏帕里生态保护区寻找伴侣.)

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1 Ep05
programme.desc: From opportunistic pirate ships, to well-armed navy vessels, Mexicos Yucatan Peninsula is steeped in maritime history.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Duck Cake
programme.desc: Bluey wants to help Dad make Bingos birthday cake, but first she must put away her toys. But nothing can tempt her to clean up, until Dad drops the cake.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Handstand
programme.desc: At a party, Bingo is desperate to show off her handstand skills, while Nanna cant find a way to make herself useful. Theyre both feeling a bit lost, until they find each other.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Road Trip
programme.desc: Mum helps Bluey and Bingo find ways to entertain themselves on a family road trip, while Dad tries to stay ahead of the grey nomad convoy or risk camping near the toilets.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Ice Cream
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want a lick of each others ice cream. But they are so focused on making sure each lick is fair, they dont notice their ice creams are melting.

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Albatross, Bird that Rides the Wind

programme.desc: Bebefinn is playing hide and seek, just like the Giant Pacific Octopus does!

programme.title: Andys Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Tiger Cubs
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the Bandhavgarh tiger reserve in India on a baby animal mission to track down a female tiger and her new born cubs. Along the way, our team outwit a sloth that strays dangerously close to the den where the cubs are resting.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. Why do my feet hurt?, he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them why is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: Its news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if hes got any news at all, remembers hes getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and thats what shes supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. Its Duggees diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels arent sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: Its a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu

programme.title: Seribu Rindu

programme.title: Citra Timur : Guangdong
programme.desc: Dokumentari Citra Timur: Guangdong mengikuti wartawan Malaysia ke Guangdong, China yang sebuah wilayah yang berkembang daripada laluan perdagangan bersejarah menjadi pusat teknologi utama dunia. Menerusi kembara ini, penonton melihat sendiri bagaimana teknologi terkini dan budaya tradisional Lingnan hidup berdampingan. Di Guangzhou dan Shenzhen, wartawan meninjau industri dron dan kecerdasan buatan AI yang memacu bandar pintar, sektor pertanian, serta sistem logistik moden. Liputan diteruskan ke sektor automotif yang menyaksikan lonjakan teknologi Kenderaan Tenaga Baharu NEV dan pemanduan autonomi, lengkap dengan sesi pandu uji serta lawatan ke kilang pemasangan pintar. Selain kemajuan teknologi, kembara ini turut mengetengahkan pertukaran budaya dan gastronomi tempatan. Wartawan meneroka tradisi kulinari Guangdong seperti hidangan dim sum serta sajian Kantonis asli, di samping menyantuni seni ukiran Lingnan dan kawasan warisan bersejarah yang masih terpelihara. Dokumentari ini memberi gambaran jelas tentang keupayaan Guangdong memacu kemajuan masa depan sambil meraikan kekayaan tradisi makanan dan warisan budayanya.

programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin Edwin Siu is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam Nancy Wu and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok Matthew Ho to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lams status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning Kelly Cheung. A war on drugs again breaks out

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Game of Deceit ((骗中传奇))
programme.desc: The tricky CHING CHEUNG KA FAI and the loafer, JIAN, CHIN KA LOK always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIANs teacher, SUN LIU KAI CHI to death. They even make the banker, HUNG LAW LOK LAUs business bankrupted and HUNGs daughter, PO, CHEUNG YUK SHAN has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN HSUAN JESSICA HESTERs female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent The First Tooth. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agents reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHINGs talent together with JIAN and LUNs assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as The Virgin Courtesan, The Twins and The Nice Weather etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

(据说,今天的新闻是明天的历史.每天有这么多新闻,每个人都很难收录一切,更不用说回顾历史.历史是一个宝藏,如果我们忽视或低估它,我们可能会错过它的财富. 新节目新闻宝藏猎引导观众从这个库中发现新闻宝石.除了特色,直播和过去的系列报道外,该节目还提供了前所未见的宝贵的镜像.观众将有机会重览诸如布鲁斯·李斯银行抢劫,四王妃团审判,香港的访问,出租车罢工,签署中英联合宣言,与玛格丽特·撒切尔的独家采访,越南难民,州长帕特登的死亡,中国航天机场的抵达,中国航天机场的报道)

programme.title: War Of Thorns ((玫瑰战争))
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying Yoyo Chen committed suicide, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung Tavia Yeung somehow obtains Tsz-yings diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her nice sisters Lai Yi-wan Rosina Lam, Lam Fung-yee Elaine Yiu, Leung Fei-nga Kelly Fu and Lam On-on Judy Kwong. To uncover the truth and avenge her friends death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film The Rose as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang Moses Chan over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-yings secret lover Lee Tak-lung Kenneth Ma and uses a series of accidents that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-yings death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyones glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Mystic Nine Whats On Today ((Mystic Nine 即将上映电影))
programme.desc: Mystic Nine tells the story of Zhang Qishan William Chan and Wu Laogou Joseph Zeng joining forces with Huo Xiangu Chen Yao and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel ((美食強人))
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into Food Guru, meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their favorite dish.

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot ((中文))
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation with limited resources, they had to use any means necessary to achieve their goals (了解当地习俗和文化的最佳方式是深入旅行,探索城市的每个角落,徒步旅行,探索整个城市的每个角落,欣赏沿途的风景,发现当地的生活和文化,迎接出乎意料的意外和挑战。 什乔里和蔡清春被一个制作团队引诱到台湾拍摄一个真实的节目。 从高雄机场开始,他们征服了300多公里,从太南到台北,在8天里访问了8个城市,每天只有1 000图亚,两个城市用他们的大脑解决交通和食品等问题,同时完成各种任务,甚至用有限的资源换房,他们不得不使用任何必要的手段实现其目标。)

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.desc: It is more than just a food and travel show as it is a cultural journey. The program blends travel, cuisine, and culture, inviting viewers not only to taste but also to experience the stories, people, and places behind Taiwanese food and destinations.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: Family Reunion
programme.desc: A lively grandmother, a warm-hearted couple and their four daughters run a tangyuan shop. Working together to prepare glutinous rice balls for every joyful occasion, the family transforms its modest business into a neighbourhood symbol of warmth, togetherness and reunion.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: The Ex-files 4: Marriage Plan ((前任4：英年早婚))
programme.desc: Two brothers, Meng Yun and Yu Fei, are of marriageable age and are facing challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, while Fei and his girlfriend opt for a marriage cooling-off period to tackle marriage issues. (孟云和优飞这两个兄弟已经到了适婚年龄,在恋爱中面临挑战。 云在分手后逃避家庭结婚的压力,而飞及其女朋友选择婚姻冷却期来解决婚姻问题。)

programme.title: Better Days (更好的日子)
programme.desc: In this Oscar nominee for Best International Feature Film, Nian faces relentless bullying from her peers as she prepares for her college entrance exam. Fate leads her to streetwise punk Bei, but before they can retreat into their own world, both are embroiled in a murder investigation that will change their lives forever.

programme.title: Death Stranding ((死亡搁浅))
programme.desc: To overhaul the underground gambling industry, the police join hands with the gambling association to crack down on illegal casinos. They auction off new casino licenses to regulate the industry, but this results in an upheaval in the gambling world, unveiling the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs...

programme.title: Tainted Love ((无法抗拒的爱))
programme.desc: Office lady Zhou Ran falls victim to an online dating love scam and is cheated of 550,000 yuan. Following faint clues left by the scammer, Zhou Ran comes to a small coastal town and encounters two young men. She gradually discovers that these two men have hidden the clues of the scam, and sets out on her revenge plan. (办公室的Zhou Ran女士成为网上约会爱情骗局的受害者,并被550,000元骗骗。 在骗徒留下微弱线索后,Zhou Ran来到一个小沿海城镇,遇到了两个年轻人。 她逐渐发现这两个男人隐藏了骗局的线索,并提出了她的报复计划。)

programme.title: Possession Street ((邪Mall))
programme.desc: When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of an abandoned mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must fight for survival. As the undead multiply and the evil spirits grow stronger, they race to stop the haunting before the entire mall descends into a living hell.

programme.title: Detrimental ((见怪))
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster. (你智廉是个盲人,他在一个外岛的工厂工作。当工厂有一天被飓风与外界隔绝时,一个怪物出现,把任何人看到它变成黑影。你看不到怪物,他能够帮助其他同事安全逃脱,并战斗杀死怪物。)

programme.title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In ((九龙城寨之围城))
programme.desc: Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the Kowloon Walled City while fleeing, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom. Bonding with Shin, Twelfth Master and AV, they unite under Tornados leadership to defend against the villain, Mr Bigs assaults, and pledge to protect the safe haven of the Walled City together. (少年陈洛克昆在逃跑时意外偶然偶然撞入了科隆城墙,随后在混乱中找到目的,并获得智慧.与辛,十二师和AV结合在一起,他们团结在一起,以防暴风雨的领导,大先生的攻击,并承诺共同保护城墙的安全港口.)

programme.title: Pass and Goal ((逆转上半场))
programme.desc: After a stock crash wipes out everything she has built, a businesswoman starts over in Sham Shui Po, forming a grassroots kids football team. Guided by a disabled coach, they prepare to face an elite squad backed by wealthy families. Caught between ambition and conscience, she resolves to use her second half to rewrite the childrens first.

programme.title: Out of Order ((乱套了))
programme.desc: A successful lawyers secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos. (一个成功的律师秘密的事件变成了梦, 当一个尸体突然出现在酒店房间,)

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella ((大话西游之大圣娶亲))
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandoras Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience ((沈默杀机))
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail. (由于Adrian大律师的尖锐疏忽,他的无辜当事人被判犯有谋杀罪并被判处17年监禁。 几年后,他有机会上诉并释放他的当事人,但为了纠正他的错误,他必须同香港最有权势的家庭之一斗争,以伸张正义。)

programme.title: No One Like Me ((乱马½))
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, the third disciple of the Imperial Astronomer, was once a golden boy. However, since the birth of Xu Qi An, his glory has waned. His relentless pursuit cannot defy a merciless truth: all has been foretold. Yet rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate. (帝国天文学家第三位门徒杨建万曾是金童。 然而,自徐琦安出生以来,他的荣耀已消逝。 他坚持不懈的追求不能违抗无情的真理:一切已早料而终。 Yang自倒台以来,却自欺欺人,自命不凡,拒绝顺从命运。)

programme.title: Shadows ((影子))
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who has the power to enter a persons subconscious mind. In her latest case, she suspects that another psychiatrist is responsible for a brutal murder-cum-suicide case involving a social worker. In the investigation process, Ching finds herself under suspicion instead, as she comes face-to-face with a past trauma

programme.title: One and Only ((我的唯一))
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the clubs top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing? (古老的街头舞者丁雷(Ding Lei)邀请热情的街头舞者陈秀去他的舞厅。 陈秀去他的舞厅。 当陈舞者与俱乐部顶尖舞者共舞时,斯帕克斯会飞翔。 陈追求他的梦想是为了表演,但发现丁氏邀请他是出于另一个原因。 由于他们两人都面对困难时期,他们能否扭转他们所面临的挑战?)

programme.title: Love Never Ends ((かぐや様は告らせたい-ファーストキッスは終わらない-))
programme.desc: An empty-nest elderly man and a widowed elderly woman who collects scrap, meet unexpectedly and gradually develop feelings for each other. An elderly couple whose wife suffers from a serious illness, makes a living by selling scrap. Both these elderly couples fall deeply in love and prove that love never ends, even if there is no tomorrow!

programme.title: Pass and Goal ((逆转上半场))
programme.desc: After a stock crash wipes out everything she has built, a businesswoman starts over in Sham Shui Po, forming a grassroots kids football team. Guided by a disabled coach, they prepare to face an elite squad backed by wealthy families. Caught between ambition and conscience, she resolves to use her second half to rewrite the childrens first.

programme.title: Call of Heroes ((Call of 英雄es))
programme.desc: Set in 1914 following the collapse of the Qing dynasty, the action-packed Call of Heroes tells the story of a group of villagers standing up to a cruel young warlord to protect their homeland. (1914年青朝垮台后, 一群村民站在一个残酷的年轻军阀面前, 保护自己的家园。)

programme.title: Old Fox ((老狐狸))
programme.desc: In 1989, young Liao Jie and his father save for a home, unaware of rising property prices. Frustrated by poverty, he learns from their landlord Old Fox who teaches him survival in society. Liao Jie ends up hurting Old Fox with what he has learnt, but his empathy prevents him from becoming like Old Fox.

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night ((风林火山))
programme.desc: Set in a snowbound, surreal Hong Kong, a tycoon who also secretly rules the drug trade is killed in an explosion, plunging the city into chaos. With police paralysed and the family businesses in turmoil, his youngest son vows to dismantle the familys empire, but is thwarted by his fugitive brother and his fathers followers fighting for control.

programme.title: Life Hotel ((奇妙酒店：大堂之外的生活))
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his fathers heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.

programme.title: Man Of Iron ((铁人))
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gangs deadly turf war.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web ((盘丝洞))
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brothers Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang. (在沙夫兄弟的第三部"向西方之旅"中,唐山宗被七个诱惑性蜘蛛灵困在困境中,他们决心通过吃他来实现不朽!)

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall ((王昭君))
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself. (王赵军拒绝贿赂帝国画家,因此他画了一张她丑陋的肖像,阻止她被皇帝选中,直到他们见面。 画家最终流亡在外,并阴谋让王朝嫁给洪军阀,以报仇。 皇帝拒绝了这一提议,挑起一场战争,只有王王自祭才能避免战争。)

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears ((英雄无泪))
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm ((血手印))
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiance, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence? (可怜的林文学家与富家女订婚,但她父亲因其家庭背景而看不起他。在出国参加皇室考试之前,林文探亲,只为了发现一个死在血中的女佣。 当现场发现他的血迹时,他成了主要嫌疑犯。 宝法官能证明他无罪吗?)

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin ((少林三十六房))
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Fast Fingers ((梁上君子))
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bills nieces! (比尔叔叔从监狱获释后,回来与过去的伙伴们一起发财。 他们继续利用那些不知情的公众,但受到正直的警察局长的密切监视,他恰好是比尔斯叔叔侄女之一的男朋友!)

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians ((卖命小子))
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agencys young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuans conspiracy leads to Guans death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: The Venus Tear Diamond ((钻石艳盗))
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love? (传奇的竞争对手珠宝盗窃者香水之夜和夜间伯爵前往日本偷走着著名的金星眼钻石. 他们一目睹就很快就恋爱了,而不知道另一个人是他们的竞争对手,并追求同样的奖励.谁将获得钻石,这将意味着他们新发现的爱情结束吗?)

programme.title: The Duel of the Century ((陆小凤之决战前后))
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies

programme.title: Diau Charn ((貂蝉))
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charns beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dongs concubine as he knows Dongs adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn. (在汉王朝,暴君总理唐祖控制了国家,因此王大臣策划用迪亚乌·查恩的美女来夺走他.王安排她成为迪亚乌·查恩的 concubine,因为他知道迪亚乌·查恩的收养儿子卢布爱上她,把他们互相反对.卢布最终杀死了东祖与迪亚乌·查恩在一起.)

programme.title: Rape of the Sword ((盗剑))
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased masters sword called the Green Frost Sword. Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: Black Magic 2 ((勾魂降头))
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sings wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients? (辛格医生对病人奇怪的症状感到困惑,并要求他的朋友帮忙.这场疾病显然是由一个邪恶的人康的黑魔法引起的.康贪图辛格妻子的美丽,并对她发出邪恶的爱情咒语,同时威胁要杀死辛格.辛格能拯救他的妻子和病患吗?)

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-killer ((猎人))
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else? (Tycoon Zhou是一个订婚的花花公子,但这并不阻止他尽可能多地对女士施展魅力。 他有一本关于他浪漫的幻想的日记,很快,他所亲密的女子就被一对一地杀害。 周成为警方的头号嫌疑犯,但凶手是另一个人吗?)

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers ((鬼画符))
programme.desc: Huan Zhus ghost seeks help from Fake Ghost Catchers Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitors ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhus sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind ((七煞))
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys? (王宫命令部长将他们推到部,并从内部拆散.随着更多内部冲突发生,)

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By ((当云匆匆消散时))
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love. (苏是一个精神分裂症患者,她拒绝相信她的飞行员爱人在飞机事故中丧生,并发明故事来处理事情.她遇到了老同学莱,他也是医生,他找到了治疗她的疾病的方法.苏慢慢恢复并接受现实,以及她的新发现的爱.)

programme.title: Vengeance ((仇念))
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lous brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Human Goddess ((仙女下凡))
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins. (第七修女,一位来自天堂的好奇仙女,降至1970年代的香港。 迷失在一个陌生的世界中,她被一个负债累累的孤儿院的东志拉普拯救。 当一个大亨用地夺取土地时,她利用自己的力量保护土地,而一个不可能发生的浪漫开始。)

programme.title: The Winged Tiger ((插翅虎))
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld Kings sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says I do?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins ((阿牛出獄記))
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity? (这场片面的喜剧看到天真阿牛来到香港,在那里他一再被剥削和利用,最终被捕入狱! 他能度过艰难的时光,克服逆境吗?)

programme.title: The Five Venoms ((撞鬼))
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: Call of the Sea ((彻夜之歌))
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yus beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair... (青少年渔民,胡爱上了他的童年朋友宇.然而,一个镇上暴徒的唯一的儿子渴望宇的美丽,并试图尽可能地接近她.胡有一天保护另一个女人免受暴徒的侵害,导致宇误解他并怀疑他们有着情侣关系.)

programme.title: The Swift Knight ((快杰狮子丸))
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperors nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue

programme.title: Pyaar Prema Kaadhal
programme.desc: Sree Kumar, a young man, falls in love with Sindhuja, a vivacious woman. However, complications soon arise and they part their separate ways only to reunite again.

programme.title: Kurup
programme.desc: Driven by greed, Kurup weaves lies, fake deaths, and identity theft. His scheme takes a twist when a clever policeman starts pursuing him.

programme.title: Aindham Vedham
programme.desc: During her mothers last rites in Varanasi, Anu is unexpectedly entrusted with an ancient relic, leading her into a mysterious and possibly life-altering journey ahead.

programme.title: Kalavani Mappillai
programme.desc: Deva, eager to marry the love of his life, tries to hide his inability to drive from his future mother-in-law. His efforts lead to hilarious situations as he tries to keep the secret.

programme.title: Kappal
programme.desc: Vaibhav wants love, but a strange promise not to marry blocks his path. He escapes to Chennai to find love, but faces foes when Sonam enters his life.

programme.title: Ko 2
programme.desc: When Kumaran, an ordinary citizen, abducts the chief minister of the state of Tamil Nadu, the whole nation wonders what could have compelled a seemingly innocent man to adopt such a drastic step.

programme.title: Pattathu Yaanai
programme.desc: Saravanan and his friends come to Trichy to set up a new restaurant business. However, their plans get interrupted when he gets an order from a local gangster but falls for his girlfriend, Aishwarya.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Officer On Duty
programme.desc: A demoted inspector investigates a counterfeit jewelry ring and becomes stuck in a deadly crime web that endangers his life and testshiscourage.

programme.title: Panirendu
programme.desc: Anand, a journalist, uncovers a microfilm exposing an underworld gangs crimes. To retrieve it, the gangster sends a woman, leading to a thrilling clash of truth and deception.

programme.title: Gandeevadhari Arjuna
programme.desc: A special agent is tasked with safeguarding a top government official from potential threats at a global climate summit, facing danger and intrigue in a mission of extreme urgency.

programme.title: Dinosaurs
programme.desc: The film revolves around two rival gangster families vying for control of the city. Their ongoing feud forms the core conflict of the story.

programme.title: Ayodhi
programme.desc: During their trip to Rameswaram, a North Indian family faces numerous misfortunes until a stranger intervenes to assist them.

programme.title: Sindhubaadh
programme.desc: Thiru, a crook, falls in love with Venba and marries her before she goes to Malaysia. However, everything turns upside down when her father sells her for the skin trade.

programme.title: Paap O Meter
programme.desc: Adding a twist to ghost comedies, three ghosts in Bhootlok are assigned with the job to scare those on earth who stray onto the path of wrong behavior.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand (最野生的新西兰)
programme.desc: New Zealands West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wilderness hides a host of endemic animals. Evolutionary castaways, every one of them is a rare ecological jewel. From alpine parrots and shy penguins to mammal-like kiwis and ancient eels. To survive the conditions the wildlife here has to be hardy, cunning and resourceful. A journey along the West Coast reveals the beauty of this land, and the trials and tribulations of the wildlife that live here. (新西兰西海岸与地球上其他地方无异。从冰川覆盖的山脉到雨水泛滥的土生林到寒冷的海洋,地貌与信仰格格不入。与世界其他地方隔绝的这片几乎未触及的荒野隐藏着大量地方性动物。进化的弃置物中,每一个都是稀有的生态珠宝。从高山鹦鹉和害羞的企鹅到哺乳动物般的kiwis和古老的动物。为了生存,野生动物必须坚韧、狡猾和有才智。沿西岸的旅程揭示了这片土地的美丽,以及生活在此地的野生动物的磨难和磨难。)

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand (最野生的新西兰)
programme.desc: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries and the life that thrives within them. (在新西兰,两个野生堡垒保护脆弱的当地动物:一个是受一条盐水护河保护的偏远岛屿,另一个是被防食性屏障包围的山顶城堡。 这就是这些微妙的保护区及其中繁衍的生命的故事。)

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand (最野生的新西兰)
programme.desc: Spring on New Zealands east coast is a time of promise for the New Zealand Fur Seal and the Norther Royal Albatross. Theyve returned to their land to breed. But harsh terrain, fickle weather and hungry predators will conspire to make lives difficult for them. Only the strongest will survive to carry forward their legacy. (新西兰东海岸的春天是新西兰富尔海豹和诺瑟皇家信天翁的希望时刻,他们回到故土繁殖。但恶劣的地形、寒冷的天气和饥饿的食肉动物会合谋给他们的生活带来困难,只有最强者才能幸存下来继承遗产。)

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand (最野生的新西兰)
programme.desc: New Zealands isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Lilliputian predators and tiny terrors that lead remarkable lives, where every hunter is also the hunted and survival is always a giant struggle. Journey into the undergrowth and discover life on a different scale. From giant carnivorous centipedes and nocturnal crickets to fishing spiders and glowing worms with silken traps. Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealands Creepiest Crawlies. (新西兰孤立的岛屿被称为非同寻常的天堂,拥有各种独特的野生动物。最著名的是无飞行鸟类、古老爬行动物和沿海哺乳动物,更近距离的目光揭示了另一个世界。一个由微型怪物、利利普天敌和微小恐怖势力组成的地方,这些微型怪物、利普天敌和微小的恐怖分子都过着非凡的生活,在那里,每个猎人也是狩猎者和生存者,这总是一场巨大的斗争。踏上下方的生长之路,在不同的规模上发现生命。从巨型食肉的幼崽和夜到捕蜘蛛和用丝网陷阱发光的蠕虫。这些无声英雄是新西兰的野兽。)

programme.title: Alaskan Summer ((阿拉斯加之夏))
programme.desc: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to August, Alaska becomes a paradise for its wildlife. (每天近20小时的阳光为丰盛的季节提供食物。温暖释放了冰川、冰洞和瀑布的水。 水撞入了无数的内河口,养活森林和野生动物。 从6月到8月,阿拉斯加成为野生动物的天堂。)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue ((马拉威野生拯救队))
programme.desc: Join the rescue as Amanda and Mandy try every trick in the book to help a snared hyena, a lion threatens a village, and the teams plan to release a troop of 13 monkeys is thwarted by last minute surgery and some crafty escape artists. (当阿曼达和曼迪试图在书中 尽一切可能帮助一只被诅咒的野狼 一只狮子威胁着一个村庄)

programme.title: Reef Wrecks (珊瑚礁碎片)
programme.desc: Bonaires fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks. These wrecks evolve over time, becoming artificial reefs that support an incredibly diverse marine habitat.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks (珊瑚礁碎片)
programme.desc: The Florida Keys is the first line of defence for the southern US. With a rich naval history and a coastal lifestyle, its easy to believe locals who claim these waters are home to as many as 1000 shipwrecks.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks (珊瑚礁碎片)
programme.desc: The Bahamas is known as the underwater movie capital of the world. Hollywood has been coming here for decades, making epic movies and TV shows in its crystal clear waters, leaving behind a host of cinematic shipwrecks.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks (珊瑚礁碎片)
programme.desc: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But its not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. Its actually a divers paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons ((野性标志))
programme.desc: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffes demise becomes a source of life for the regions vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these. (Marakele国家公园的冬季是一年中最稀少但也是最漫长的时期之一。 看看长颈鹿的消亡是如何成为秃鹫地区生命来源的,秃鹫的生存取决于这些动物的腐烂肉。)

programme.title: Wildlife Icons ((野性标志))
programme.desc: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the regions species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the citys shrinking wetlands. (南非开普敦有20种青蛙,但许多青蛙受到城市发展的威胁。 我们跟随西部豹蛤蛙在不断萎缩的湿地繁殖的脆弱旅程中走过,与许多区域物种相遇。)

programme.title: Wildlife Icons ((野性标志))
programme.desc: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future. (非洲大象人口曾经由于狩猎而大量减少。 深入观察地球上最强大的陆地哺乳动物的生活,看看像Addo和Tembe这样的公园在保护他们的未来。)

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge (饥饿运动会:阿拉斯加大熊挑战)
programme.desc: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova. (随着比赛的第一阶段开始,醒来后,与7个饥饿的熊一起息.与新BoldFace战斗狼,看看小的马对抗权力和白的爱,)

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge (饥饿运动会:阿拉斯加大熊挑战)
programme.desc: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe. (加入狂热的冲击,以利的鱼运行,与第一阶段的获胜者和一些艰难的新兵一起. 加入BigBois的食物探险之旅,欢迎QuadMom和RedBack到宴会上,)

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge (饥饿运动会:阿拉斯加大熊挑战)
programme.desc: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown? (10月的暴风雨让比赛复杂化到终点线。 看到大博伊在悲剧袭击QuadMom之前遭遇了一次绊脚石后弹起,而欢呼的粉丝们在她紧紧缠的小孩Raccoon的脚步中弹起舞来。 但是谁会戴上王冠呢?)

programme.title: In For The Kill ((Kill it 雙面殺手))
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home. (捕食者在捕食猎物时使用狡猾、敏捷和敏捷的速度。 目击证人诱惑行为,看一些杀手如何隐藏在眼中,而其他人则用武器或化学战将晚餐带回家。)

programme.title: Mysteries Of Evolution ((Mysteries Of X战警：进化))
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered why mandrills have such colorful faces, why vultures are bald, or even why hammerheads have, well, hammer-shaped heads? Discover how animals managed to survive by evolving from the neck up.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon ((Wild Side of 从地球到月球))
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon ((Wild Side of 从地球到月球))
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives
programme.desc: Chart the lions nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins. (亲眼目睹动物的能力,超出人类的能力. 通过敏感的顶,鱼如何检测到最小的运动,发现子内部的GPS系统,并使用第七感来检测海豚的猎物.)

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))
programme.desc: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks. (使用自然界最狡猾、最有弹性的战斗机部署生化武器。 与科莫多龙一起释放毒气,用蒙古暴徒抵抗有毒的敌人,并看到鸟类用打骨的力量来对付有毒的攻击。)

programme.title: Wild Latin America ((魅力南美洲))
programme.desc: Get to know South Americas only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru. (亲眼目睹眼熊的尬和魅力,玩,食,并在秘鲁北部的偏远的夏帕里生态保护区寻找伴侣.)

programme.title: 少林三十六房

programme.title: 梁上君子

programme.title: 陆小凤之决战前后

programme.title: 盗剑

programme.title: 勾魂降头
programme.desc: 青年医生时振声在医院中发现很多奇难杂症，无法以医学理论解释，遂请好友齐中平夫妇共同研究几经追查，才发现那些病人均是中了降头原来施降者是精通邪术，以爱情降头协助富商追求梦中情人，博取巨额报酬中平不信妖邪之说，其妻子更不惜以身相试，更被施以死降，如果无法破解，二十四小时后便会身亡...

programme.title: 猎人

programme.title: 鬼画符

programme.title: 七煞

programme.title: 云泥

programme.title: 报仇

programme.title: 仙女下凡

programme.title: 我爱神仙遮
programme.desc: 推土车司机阿成，在工作时忽遇地陷而堕入一地下古庙，无意中成为油纸伞妖的主人她更将自己现身的秘密及超凡的法力告知阿成地盘工目凡叔嗜赌，欠下恶少高利贷，恶少垂涎凡叔之女美色，要凡叔以女还债；阿成得悉后请伞妖戏弄恶少，并暗助凡叔在赌场获胜，清还债项惟此神伞之秘密却被恶少发现

programme.title: 霍家拳之精武英雄
programme.desc: 陈真奉师命赴日求学，因解救并爱上校友山田广子，就此陷入日本黑龙会的权力纷争面对华人学生接连失踪黑龙会渗透打压精武门，他联手热血青年梁少文深入敌营，捣毁秘密实验室并瓦解阴谋，与强敌展开生死决战，誓死守护民族尊严

programme.title: 十万火急
programme.desc: 这是关于香港消防员的英勇救火故事勇敢的消防员无惧冲天大火，肩负救灾扶危的重任，甚至舍身救人但当消防员脱下制服后，是否仍同样勇敢地面对自身的难题呢？

programme.title: 消失的子弹
programme.desc: 民国初年，一家兵工厂发生离奇连环命案死者皆死于枪击，现场却遍寻不到弹头，引发幽灵子弹索命恐慌警政官松东路与热血神枪手郭追受命联手侦破此案随着调查深入，两人发现阿森纳内黑幕重重，而真相竟隐藏在一个关于正义与人性堕落的惊人诡计之中

programme.title: 破坏之王
programme.desc: 外卖员何金银为让他的女神阿丽对他刮目相看，发奋习武，并学了奇怪的招式胆小怕事的他一次头戴加菲猫面具拯救了阿丽，不料事后被空手道大师段水流领功银为揭穿真相，最终在擂台使出绝招无敌风火轮击败段大师，并抱得美人归

programme.title: 怒袭
programme.desc: 前特种兵阿龙为调查记者女儿安心在跨境犯罪园区失踪一事，孤身深入这座由金钱与血腥统治的人间炼狱，揭开电信诈骗地下血库等黑暗内幕当发现女儿已卷入更大阴谋，暴怒的阿龙化身冷酷杀神，以铁血手段血战罪恶势力，誓要揪出幕后黑手

programme.title: 猩猩王
programme.desc: 探险家陈正风（李修贤）受聘赴印度森林搜捕猩猩王，结果误堕娱乐公司老板鲁天（谷峰）的圈套，将猩猩王带往香港表演同行的女泰山阿维（伊芙莲嘉）见猩猩王惨遭捉弄摆布，伤心之余更被鲁天意图强奸猩猩王睹状狂性大发，追击鲁天至市区，市民一片慌乱，军警如临大敌...全片的特技道具，一丝不苟，猩猩王爬上香港当时最高建筑物康乐大厦的镜头，令观众惊异万分导演远赴泰国森林取景，还有野性美丽的女泰山伊芙莲嘉演出，令人大饱眼福

programme.title: 怪谈
programme.desc: 在迷雾村，为人养子的文杰反复梦见同一个噩梦为了解开身世之谜，他卷入连串神秘的失踪案件中随着更多村民相继离奇死去，村民更深信不疑千年来的井龙王诅咒于是，文杰与保安队长联手探寻真相，揭开反派阴谋，最终拯救被危害的无辜村民.

programme.title: 青蛙王子
programme.desc: 此喜剧在夏威夷开始，富家子为人腼腆，追女乏术，好友充当其爱情顾问，带他四出泡妞，却碰得一鼻子灰，闹出连场笑话

programme.title: 龙门飞甲
programme.desc: 本片重拍自1966年经典武侠片龙门客栈，当时东厂与西厂宦官掌控朝政，腐败横行侠客赵怀安与一群刺客联手，秘密铲除宦官势力，维护忠良与国家安定

programme.title: 一眉道人
programme.desc: 一眉道长与徒弟隐居于偏远村庄某日，玛利亚修女计画重建一座荒废已久的教堂，却意外唤醒沉睡多年的僵尸黑袍传教士全镇顿时陷入恐慌，面对传统茅山术失效的绝境，一眉道长唯有与西方驱魔神父联手，融合中西驱魔之法，展开一场惊心动魄的驱魔大战

programme.title: 宝贝计划
programme.desc: 城中著名的盗贼三人组受聘以3000万元绑架一名婴孩当他们发现黑帮不仅企图吞掉赎金，更要置婴孩于死地后，决定担起保护婴孩的责任，并护送他平安回家一方面要躲避警方追捕，另一方面又遭黑帮穷追不舍，三人即使危机四伏，仍誓死守护婴孩

programme.title: 打雀英雄传
programme.desc: 足智多谋的麻雀英雄，为避免年轻电脑专家的麻雀馆落入麻雀千王手上，不惜重新出山与千王鏖战

programme.title: 追女三十六房
programme.desc: 故事描述一间猛男训练中心专门教授男人在情场上的杀着可惜校长与其女友缠绵时不幸暴毙，学校三位教授想出招数争夺学校拥有权，闹出连场笑话...

programme.title: 怒袭

programme.title: 鬼马飞人
programme.desc: 阿B为一名中学的体育教师，其执教之学校篮足球队成绩甚差，学校下令他务必赢得校际比赛冠军，否则将撤换教练阿B因头痛，误服同事研制之神药，变成超人，令球队屡次创造奇迹...

programme.title: 大内密探零零发

programme.title: 西游记第壹百零壹回之月光宝盒
programme.desc: 逍遥山贼斧头帮帮主至尊宝，意外得知自己是孙悟空的转世随着妖魔与仙界势力逼近，他被卷入月光宝盒引发的时空混乱之中在爱恨纠葛与不可违抗宿命之间，他必须在凡人身份与救世重任中作出抉择

programme.title: 赌城大亨II 之至尊无敌
programme.desc: 本片是赌城大亨之新哥传奇的续集，讲述贺新用了20年时间，成功建立其赌业王国，但同伴却不甘屈居其下，于是设局争夺赌业控制权另一方面，青年傅震为贺新旧情人的儿子，以为父亲被新所杀，便处心积虑安排报仇大计胆识过人的贺新面对各样的威胁，绝不坐以待弊

programme.desc: 影后关子盈陈自瑶饰自杀七年后，其挚友夏无双杨茜尧饰意外获得子盈的日记，惊悉她当年疑遭好姊妹黎绮云林夏薇饰蓝凤仪姚子羚饰梁菲雅傅嘉莉饰林安安邝洁楹饰背叛与加害为追查背后真相及复仇，无双以合拍电影玫瑰作诱饵，博取娱乐公司老板陈云生陈豪饰的信任，拉拢四女参演无双连手子盈的秘密情人李德龙马国明饰，并藉复制子盈曾遭遇的连串意外，挑起四女互撕随着子盈被资本势力胁迫致死的真相逐渐浮现，众人光鲜亮丽的伪装瞬间粉碎，暴露出最不堪的人性阴暗面

programme.title: 九门 第29集
programme.desc: 九门讲述了长沙风云再起之时，张启山（陈伟霆 饰）与吴老狗（曾舜晞 饰）强强连手，携手霍仙姑（陈瑶 饰）与九门诸人共赴冒险奇局

programme.title: 跟风旅行团
programme.desc: 跟风，意谓跟随一种风尚或潮流主持杜如风看过网上平台的百万点击影片，百分百跟着片中人的踪迹，逛游韩国首尔的购物点玩乐点，吃尽片内的餐厅小店美食推介，到底百万人看过的片段，是呃Like引人中伏，还是值得一推？如风化身真人版键盘战士，留下超真实评语除此之外，跟风亦可以有另一个意思，就是跟随任性如风的私心推介，继而自行创造独特的旅程，让观众也可名正言顺地跟风！

programme.title: 娱乐头条

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第12集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变......

programme.title: 爱情食物链 第21集
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾......

programme.title: 状王之王 第7集
programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰王浩信饰因父亲宋安张达明饰是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信林子聪饰中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九金刚饰浪游天下世杰及后却被卷进蜘蛛精杀人案中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑姚子羚饰......案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案......
